description: HTML Widget. Renders arbitrary custom HTML/CSS in an isolated sandbox (sandbox attribute always present, allow-same-origin never granted). Scripts run only from the html content when allowScripts is on. Communicates via window.postMessage with envelope { type: 'jet-html-message', widgetID, payload }.

html.description: Full HTML document content (or body fragment)

js.description: DEPRECATED/unsupported: ignored by the renderer. Put scripts in `html` and enable `allowScripts`. Kept so old saved configs still validate.

allowScripts.description: Allow <script> execution inside the sandbox. Default false.

allowForms.description: Allow form submission inside the sandbox. Default false.

allowPopups.description: Allow popups/new tabs from the sandbox. Default false.
